2. Sample Data for Initial Load.

DEMOGRAPHICID=5728236 will be updated on the next run
DEMOGRAPHICID=6594802 will be deleted from the source on the next run
DEMOGRAPHICID=2406201 will have no change in details, only filename date will be changed
DEMOGRAPHICID=99999999 will be inserted as new record in the source on the next run(not yet inserted on the target table)


SELECT * FROM
EDS.CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC WHERE DEMOGRAPHICID=5728236
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM
EDS.CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC WHERE DEMOGRAPHICID=6594802
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM
EDS.CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC WHERE DEMOGRAPHICID=2406201
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM
EDS.CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC WHERE DEMOGRAPHICID=99999999


3. Run scripts to fabricate updated, deleted , new record and update filename date

UPDATE [d360].[STG_EDS_CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC] SET RESIDENTIAL_STATUS='TEST123',RACE = 'TEST123'
WHERE DEMOGRAPHICID=5728236 AND H = 'D';

DELETE FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC]
WHERE DEMOGRAPHICID=6594802 AND H = 'D';

UPDATE [d360].[STG_EDS_CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC] SET FILE_NAME=REPLACE(FILE_NAME,'20230905','20230906');
